newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shun Shing says may buy assets from COSCO.
newsitem.headline: Shun Shing says may buy assets from COSCO.

text.p: Construction and property group Shun Shing Holdings Ltd said on Monday it was considering the possibility of buying assets from its holding company, COSCO (Hong Kong) Group Ltd.

"The company is considering the possibility of acquisitions of assets from COSCO Hong Kong as well as from independent third parties," Shun Shing said in a statement. "Discussion are still at a preliminary stage and nothing has been finalised."
Shun Shing said assets under consideration included office, residential property and hotel redevelopment projects in Hong Kong and in Guangzhou, Shanghai, Beijing and Tianjin in China.
It said it was also considering buying a coal-fire power plant in Henan, a toll highway in Yunnan, a hydro-electric power plant in Jianngxi and a toll bridge in Guangdong.
Shun Shing is also considering buying into certain locally-listed companies involved in hotel operation and management, property development and toll road operation in China, it said.
"It is not possible at this stage to determine the total consideration payable by the company for such acquisitions," it said.
Shun Shing shares rose HK$0.30 to HK$9.20 in late trade.
COSCO (Hong Kong), a wholly-owned unit of China's China Ocean Shipping (Group) Co (COSCO), is the parent of COSCO Pacific Ltd.
